title: Portfolio: an end-to-end analysis project that shows your process

videos.script: A dashboard in a portfolio shows that you can build a dashboard. It does not show that you can turn a question into a decision. {{dashboard}} That is what somebody hiring an analyst is trying to find out. Can this person take a vague question, find what matters in the data, and get a room to act on it? {{hiring}} The only way to show that is to show the process. The question as it was asked. What you ruled out. The finding, the recommendation, and what happened next. Including what went wrong. {{process}} This lesson packages Faro's analysis as a case study, the way you would package your own. Then it helps you choose yours. {{choose}} And it says where this portfolio ends and the next course's begins, so you build one project, not two. {{one}}
